examples.en: Life on the farm is a bed of roses for him because his family handles most of the hard work.
examples.zh: 他的家人負責大部分艱苦工作，因此他在農場的生活輕鬆舒適。

examples.en: Running the café is not a bed of roses.
examples.zh: 經營這間咖啡店並不輕鬆。

meaning.en: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.
meaning.zh: 一個輕鬆、愉快、舒適，而且大致沒有困難或煩惱的處境或生活。

register.summaryEn: A bed of roses is a common idiomatic noun phrase. It is natural in conversation, general writing, interviews, articles and informal workplace communication.
register.summaryZh: A bed of roses 是一個常見的慣用名詞短語，適合用於日常對話、一般文章、訪問、報道及非正式工作溝通。
register.formalEn: Both are correct, but the first is more direct and formal.

examples.en: Running the café is not a bed of roses because we must begin work at five every morning.
examples.zh: 經營這間咖啡店並不輕鬆，因為我們每天早上五時便要開始工作。

benefits.titleEn: It Gives a Compact Overall Evaluation
benefits.en: The idiom compresses several difficulties into one overall judgement.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語把多項困難濃縮成一個整體評價。

benefits.en: She thought working from home would be a bed of roses, but she now attends online meetings all day. The expression is useful when something looked easy before the speaker experienced it.
benefits.zh: 她以為在家工作會十分輕鬆，但現在整天都要參加網上會議。 當某件事情在親身經歷前看來十分輕鬆時，這個表達尤其實用。

benefits.titleEn: It Works in Both Positive and Negative Statements
benefits.titleZh: 可用於肯定句和否定句
benefits.en: It Works in Both Positive and Negative Statements
benefits.zh: 可用於肯定句和否定句

benefits.titleEn: It Adds Variety to Opinions and Reflections
benefits.titleZh: 增加表達意見及反思的變化

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful for Warnings and Advice
benefits.en: The expression can gently correct unrealistic expectations.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以較婉轉地糾正不切實際的期望。

origin.statusEn: Gradual Development; Exact First Idiomatic Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切首次比喻用法不明

history.en: Merriam-Webster dates its first known use of bed of roses in the present sense to 1576. Another historical idiom reference dates the metaphorical expression to 1635. These dates refer to located written evidence, not necessarily the first time anyone spoke the expression.
history.zh: Merriam-Webster 把目前意思的 bed of roses 最早已知用法追溯至1576年。 另一項歷史慣用語資料則把比喻用法追溯至1635年。 這些年份代表現時找到的書面記錄，並不一定是人們首次說出這個表達的時間。

history.en: Because roses were connected with beauty, pleasant smells, romance and luxury, a bed covered with roses became a natural image of an easy and delightful existence. The image gradually developed into a fixed expression for any comfortable or trouble-free situation.
history.zh: 由於玫瑰令人聯想到美麗、芳香、浪漫和奢華，鋪滿玫瑰的睡床自然成為輕鬆愉快生活的象徵。 這個畫面逐漸演變成固定表達，用來形容任何舒適而沒有太多煩惱的處境。

origin.memoryEn: A soft bed covered in beautiful roses represents comfort without struggle.
origin.memoryZh: 鋪滿美麗玫瑰的柔軟睡床，象徵沒有艱苦的舒適生活。

rules.titleZh: 冠詞 a 通常是目標表達的一部分
rules.en: The article a is normally part of the target expression.
rules.zh: 冠詞 a 通常是目標表達的一部分。

rules.titleZh: 花園內有一大片種植玫瑰的花圃
rules.en: The garden contains a large bed of roses. The exercise uses only the idiomatic meaning.
rules.zh: 花園內有一大片種植玫瑰的花圃。 她的新生活看來十分舒適寫意。 本練習只使用比喻意思。

examples.en: Her new life seemed like a bed of roses.
examples.zh: 她的新生活看來十分舒適寫意。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for One Small Easy Task
rules.en: The expression usually describes a situation, period of life, job, relationship, process or general experience. For one easy task, say:
rules.zh: 這個表達通常描述一個處境、一段生活、工作、關係、過程或整體經歷。 項目的第一年並不順利。 打開這個瓶子是一段輕鬆愉快的生活。 對於一項簡單工作，可以說：

examples.en: The first year of the project was not a bed of roses.
examples.zh: 項目的第一年並不順利。

examples.en: Opening this bottle was a bed of roses.
examples.zh: 打開這個瓶子是一段輕鬆愉快的生活。

rules.en: The incorrect answer changes a possibility into a completed fact.
rules.zh: 錯誤答案把可能發生的情況變成已經發生的事實。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Overstate a Minor Difficulty
rules.en: A bed of roses normally describes general ease and comfort. A single small problem may not justify a negative idiomatic judgement of the entire experience. The source does not establish enough difficulty.
rules.zh: A bed of roses 通常描述整體上的輕鬆和舒適。 單一的小問題未必足以把整段經歷形容為困難。 原句沒有交代足夠困難。

rules.titleEn: “No Bed of Roses” Is a Related Variant
rules.titleZh: 自然英語也有以下形式：
rules.en: Natural English also includes: However, this exercise trains the exact target: The questions therefore use forms such as:
rules.zh: 不過，本練習只訓練以下確切形式： 因此，題目會使用以下形式：

rules.en: The expression is often negative, but positive use is also correct when a situation genuinely is easy, pleasant and comfortable. Do not force every answer into a negative form.
rules.zh: 這個表達經常用於否定句，但如果一個處境確實輕鬆、愉快和舒適，肯定用法也是正確的。 清還債務後，一家人的生活變得舒適順利。 不要把所有答案都勉強寫成否定形式。

examples.en: After the debts were paid, life became a bed of roses for the family.
examples.zh: 清還債務後，一家人的生活變得舒適順利。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using a bed of roses.
instructions.zh: 使用 a bed of roses 改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: His family does nearly all the difficult work on the farm, so his daily life there is easy and comfortable.
questions.promptZh: 他的家人負責農場上幾乎所有艱苦工作，因此他在那裏的日常生活輕鬆舒適。
questions.answer: Life on the farm is a bed of roses for him because his family handles most of the hard work.
questions.answerZh: 他的家人負責大部分艱苦工作，因此他在農場的生活輕鬆舒適。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: During her first month at the new job, she had short working hours, friendly colleagues and almost no pressure.
questions.promptZh: 在新工作的第一個月，她工時短、同事友善，而且幾乎沒有壓力。
questions.answer: The first month at her new job was a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 她在新工作的第一個月過得輕鬆愉快。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Looking after three young children involves sleepless nights, constant cleaning and very little rest.
questions.promptZh: 照顧三名年幼孩子需要面對失眠的晚上、不停清潔和很少休息。
questions.answer: Caring for three young children is not a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 照顧三名年幼孩子並不是一件輕鬆的事情。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Her family had little money during her childhood, and they had to move home many times.
questions.promptZh: 她童年時家境貧困，而且一家人需要多次搬家。
questions.answer: Her childhood was not a bed of roses because her family moved often and had little money.
questions.answerZh: 她的童年並不安逸，因為一家人經常搬家，而且家境貧困。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: They expected retirement to be relaxing, but the first few months brought health problems and loneliness.
questions.promptZh: 他們以為退休生活會十分悠閒，但最初幾個月卻帶來健康問題和孤獨感。
questions.answer: Retirement was not a bed of roses for them at first.
questions.answerZh: 最初，他們的退休生活並不輕鬆愉快。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Owning a small café means beginning work early, dealing with complaints and checking the money every evening.
questions.promptZh: 經營一間小型咖啡店，意味著要早早開始工作、處理投訴，並在每天晚上核對帳目。
questions.answer: Running a small café is not a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 經營一間小型咖啡店並不輕鬆。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: The first lessons were easy, but the course became difficult when the major assignments began.
questions.promptZh: 最初幾課十分容易，但開始進行大型習作後，課程便變得困難。
questions.answer: The course was not a bed of roses once the difficult work began.
questions.answerZh: 困難的工作開始後，這個課程便不再輕鬆。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Kay had difficulty finding a flat, making friends and getting used to her new city.
questions.promptZh: Kay 很難找到住所、結交朋友及適應新城市。
questions.answer: Moving to a new city was not a bed of roses for Kay.
questions.answerZh: 對 Kay 來說，搬到新城市生活並不順利。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Caring for a sick parent can involve worry, hospital visits and very little sleep.
questions.promptZh: 照顧患病的父母可能涉及憂慮、到醫院探望和很少睡眠。
questions.answer: Looking after an ill parent is not a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 照顧患病的父母並不是一件輕鬆的事情。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: People who work throughout the night often feel tired and miss time with their families.
questions.promptZh: 通宵工作的人經常感到疲倦，也會錯過與家人相處的時間。
questions.answer: Working night shifts is hardly a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 上夜班絕不是輕鬆舒適的生活。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Her online photographs show holidays and expensive meals, but they do not show her debts or family problems.
questions.promptZh: 她的網上照片展示假期和昂貴的膳食，卻沒有展示她的債務或家庭問題。
questions.answer: Her life may look like a bed of roses online, but she still faces many problems.
questions.answerZh: 她的生活在網上看來十分稱心如意，但她仍面對許多問題。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Once the business has paid all its debts and gained regular customers, running it could become easy and comfortable.
questions.promptZh: 這盤生意清還所有債務並有穩定顧客後，經營工作可能會變得輕鬆舒適。
questions.answer: The business could become a bed of roses once its debts are paid.
questions.answerZh: 清還債務後，經營這盤生意可能會變得輕鬆得多。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: The school trip could become difficult if heavy rain causes delays and outdoor activities are cancelled.
questions.promptZh: 如果大雨造成延誤及戶外活動取消，學校旅行可能會變得困難。
questions.answer: The school trip may not be a bed of roses if the weather turns bad.
questions.answerZh: 如果天氣轉壞，學校旅行可能不會十分順利。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: University includes deadlines, difficult classes, cooking and managing your own money. Do not assume that it will always be easy.
questions.promptZh: 大學生活包括限期、困難的課堂、煮食和自行管理金錢。不要以為一切都會很輕鬆。
questions.answer: You should not expect university life to be a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 你不應以為大學生活會事事稱心如意。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Nobody told us that our first year in another country would be easy and free from difficulties.
questions.promptZh: 沒有人告訴我們，在另一個國家生活的第一年會輕鬆而沒有困難。
questions.answer: No one promised that the first year abroad would be a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 沒有人承諾海外生活的第一年會輕鬆順利。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Daniel thought that working from home would be completely relaxing, but he now attends online meetings throughout the day.
questions.promptZh: Daniel 以為在家工作會十分輕鬆，但他現在整天都要參加網上會議。
questions.answer: Daniel imagined that working from home would be a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: Daniel 以為在家工作會十分輕鬆愉快。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: The course information mentioned only easy lessons, friendly teachers and enjoyable activities.
questions.promptZh: 課程資料只提到容易的課堂、友善的老師和愉快的活動。
questions.answer: The brochure made the course sound like a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 課程小冊子把這個課程形容得輕鬆又理想。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: Her new position offered high pay and a private office, so people outside the company thought it was easy and comfortable.
questions.promptZh: 她的新職位提供高薪和私人辦公室，因此公司以外的人以為這份工作輕鬆舒適。
questions.answer: From the outside, her new role seemed like a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 從外人的角度看，她的新職位似乎十分輕鬆理想。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: The manager said the transfer would bring shorter hours, easier work and no serious problems.
questions.promptZh: 經理表示調職後工時會更短、工作會更容易，而且不會有嚴重問題。
questions.answer: The manager presented the transfer as a bed of roses.
questions.answerZh: 經理把這次調職描繪得十分輕鬆理想。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: The family can make the move much easier by arranging the new home, school and jobs before leaving.
questions.promptZh: 這個家庭可以在離開前安排新居、學校和工作，令搬遷過程容易得多。
questions.answer: Good planning can make the move a bed of roses for the whole family.
questions.answerZh: 周詳的計劃可以令整個家庭的搬遷過程變得輕鬆順利。
questions.targetMeaning: A situation or way of life that is easy, pleasant, comfortable and largely free from problems.

questions.prompt: A: You said this job would be relaxing. B: I know, but I now work twelve hours on some days.
questions.promptZh: 甲：你曾說這份工作會很輕鬆。 乙：我知道，但有些日子我現在要工作十二小時。
questions.answer: I thought this job would be a bed of roses, but the hours are exhausting.
questions.answerZh: 我曾以為這份工作會十分輕鬆，但工時令人筋疲力盡。
